scenario_text: Two adjacent parallel streams of fluid move at different speeds, creating a thin shear layer between them. A small sinusoidal ripple at the interface can grow when the velocity difference is large enough, drawing energy from the shear. We follow the amplitude of the interface perturbation as it develops in time.
